power.automation.rules.title: Global settings
power.automation.rules.description: These apply to every printer. A printer turns off by itself only after a print that finished. It stays on after a cancelled or a failed print, and for as long as a print is paused.
power.automation.delay.label: Global wait before turning off after a print
power.automation.delay.hint: For every printer that turns off after a print and has no wait of its own below. The plug stays on this long after the print ends and the printer stops moving, so the nozzle can cool.
power.automation.confirm.label: Ask before turning off by hand
power.automation.confirm.hint: Turning off cuts the printer's mains power. With this off, one press on Turn off does it.
power.automation.printers.title: Defaults for each printer
power.automation.printers.description: What each printer does unless you say otherwise. A printer switched on here turns off after every print. On the printer's own page you can still switch this on or off for a single print. Each printer waits the global time ({delay}), unless you give it a wait of its own here.
power.switch.askNote: This cuts the printer's mains power. Make sure the printer is idle and the nozzle has cooled down.
